definitions.full: H7352. rechiq [ רְחִיק ] adjective far ; — plural absolute מִןתַּֿמָּה הֲווֺ רְחִיקִין Ezra 6:6 , i.e. keep aloof. רֵיחַ see רוח .

occurrences.englishText: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.
